about: Issues in seeded/. Each one passes typecheck and lint, so only review can catch it. Every planted issue must be caught on every run. Issues marked required: false are real but incidental, found by reviews rather than planted; they're scored as recall and don't fail the eval, because runs vary in which of them they report. A finding catches an issue when it names the same file, one of its rules, and a line from the anchor (or 2 lines before it) to the 'through' line (or 2 after it).
